description_en: Creates a one-time virus scan task
description_zh: 创建病毒扫描一次性任务
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-virus-scan-once-task --selection-key 845de1ec-4b08-42e1-b564-31321e48xxxx --scan-type system --scan-path /var/spool/cron --param additionType_:_SCAN_MEMORY --client-token example-string --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVirusScanOnceTask

parameters.help_en:
The key that stores asset information.
You can call the [GetAssetSelectionConfig](~~GetAssetSelectionConfig~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
保存资产信息的键值。
您可以调用[GetAssetSelectionConfig](~~GetAssetSelectionConfig~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: selection_key

parameters.help_en:
The scan type of the virus scan. Valid values:
system: system scan
user: custom scan
parameters.help_zh:
病毒扫描的扫描类型。取值：
system：系统扫描
user：自定义扫描
parameters.name: scan_type

parameters.help_en: The scan path information to be transmitted if the scan type is custom scan
parameters.help_zh: 如果是自定义扫描需要传输的扫描路径信息
parameters.name: scan_path

parameters.help_en:
The extended information field:
additionType: the extended scan type
parameters.help_zh:
扩展信息字段：
additionType：拓展的扫描类型
parameters.name: param

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token
